text.description_html:
The Schlage F-LAT-COL is a Latitude door lever set paired with the Collins square rose, designed for modern residential interior and exterior doors. The square rose features concealed screws for a clean installation profile. Available in five finishes across dummy, passage, privacy, and keyed entry functions.

Backset is adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4", fitting standard pre-drilled door prep. The lever set accommodates door thicknesses from 1-3/8" to 1-3/4". The lever and trim rose are solid brass; the tubular lock housing is pressure-cast zinc.

Schlage rates this lever at ANSI A156.2 Series 4000 Grade 2 for residential keyed entry. A lifetime mechanical warranty applies to residential applications.
features: Adjustable backset - fits 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" for standard residential door prep
Solid brass lever and rose - resistant to tarnish, discoloration, and corrosion
Four function options - dummy, passage, privacy, and keyed entry cover most residential applications
Five finish options - coordinate with existing hardware without special orders
Square rose with concealed screws - clean installation appearance on modern doors
Door thickness range 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" - fits standard residential interior and exterior doors
ANSI A156.2 Grade 2 rated keyed entry - verified performance for residential applications
Lifetime mechanical warranty - manufacturer-backed durability for residential use

text_raw.description_html_input:
Schlage F-Series, Latitude Door Lever Set With Collins Rose

The clean design of Schlage's Collins Collection Rose with Latitude Lever is perfect for even the most modern home. The square rose has concealed screws. It fits standard door cutouts and has an adjustable backset for 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. It is adjustable for 1-3/8 inches up to 1-3/4 inches door thicknesses. The look of this leverset makes it the perfect addition to any modern space. Available in 5 finishes in single dummy, passage, privacy, and keyed entry functions.

When you install Schlage lever, you safeguard your home and family as well as your peace of mind. Schlage door levers are resistant to tarnishing, discoloration and corrosion. Plus, the wide variety of finishes may make your decision tough--just like this lever.

Features of the Schlage Latitude Door Lever:

  • One piece knob for better security and appearance.
  • Fits standard pre-drilled doors.
  • ANSI A156.2 series 4000 grade 2 keyed entry function.
  • Pressure-cast zinc tubular lock housing.
  • Lifetime mechanical warranty on residential applications.
  • Solid brass lever and trim rose.
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the F-Series Schlage Latitude Door Lever Collins Collection:

  • Lever Length: 4"
  • Rose: 2-3/4" Square
  • Adjustable Backset for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4" thick doors
  • Faceplate: 1" x 2-1/4" Round Corner (1/4" radius corners)
  • Housing Diameter: 7/8"
  • Throw: 1/2"
  • Strike Plate: 1-5/8" x 2-1/4" Round Corner Full Lip Strike Plate

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim on one side of the door. It does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. The lock is activated by a push button in the center of the lever while turning the inside lever releases the lock. It can be opened from the outside with a small circular tool.
  • Keyed Entry (Keyed Lock): Use when a handle operated by a lock is needed. Unlocked by a key from the outside when locked by inside turn button. Inside always unlocked.

The Emtek AS6-PKTMORTLCK is a replacement mortise lock body for Emtek pocket door privacy function locks. It fits a 1-3/8-inch thick door and installs in a mortise cavity measuring 6-1/4 inches tall by 3-3/8 inches wide.

The privacy finger pull is activated by pressing the button on the mortise faceplate and retracted by pressing it flush with the faceplate. Non-handed design installs on either door orientation without modification. Package includes the lock body only.

text.description_html:
The PDQ 4200VA-605 is a Grade 1 commercial surface vertical rod exit device for doors 38 to 48 inches wide in Polished Brass (605) finish. Touch bar components are constructed from heavy gauge wrought steel or stainless steel, with a cadmium-plated steel chassis and metal end caps.

Non fire-rated units include hex key dogging as standard; fire-labeled units are furnished with sex nuts. Fasteners are included for both wood and metal door applications. Requires a minimum stile width of 4-1/4 inches on 1-3/4-inch thick doors. Stainless steel dead-locking latch with 5/8-inch throw.

Listed by UL/ULC and compliant with UL 10C and UBC 7-2 (1997). Meets Buy American Act requirements and ICC/ANSI 117.1 for accessible buildings. Carries a five-year manufacturer's warranty. Sold individually.
features: Grade 1 commercial rating - built for high-traffic and life safety door applications
Fits 38" to 48" door width - covers oversized commercial single and narrow double door openings
UL/ULC 305 listed and UL 10C compliant - verified for panic hardware and fire exit hardware

Non-handed - installs on any door without specifying hand
Hex key dogging standard on non-fire-rated units - allows push/pull operation during occupied hours

Five-year manufacturer's warranty - commercial-grade durability assurance
